title: 第1160章 乱第1159章 若水
content_zh:
“五长老他就在那里”
魔眼宗的飞舟之上薛闵圭一行人正围着一个身穿青袍的中年男子指着下方说道
那是一处山崖之上，一袭紫袍的老人盘腿坐在磐石之上，他的面容苍白如雪，在其头顶之上却有一柄金光小剑正闪烁着微光
在其身旁一名黑裙异域女子蹲在身前替他擦拭着滚滚如浆的汗水
“这是什么情况，难道他要成剑意了？
薛闵圭不由疑惑道
“嗯，的确如此”
青袍男子冷哼一声
他乃是魔眼宗五长老禹坤，人称青眼魔君，实力达到了化神级
“呵呵，他的这股剑意倒是不错，可以为我所用”
大笑着禹坤已然动了，他的身影瞬间出现在了杨威身前，抬手便按压在了他的额头上
“你是什么人，快放开老爷”
扎娜见状欲要阻拦结果被一道灵光震飞撞击在山石上晕了过去
“好强的剑意，哈哈哈，若是将之交给吃剑老鬼，想必报酬少不了”
禹坤心中盘算着，原本当面报仇的心思也淡了，先取了这小子的剑意再杀也不迟
“你小子可真倒霉”
筱梦真君自然也看到了禹坤的出现，这可是实打实的化神修士这下他们也没办法了
“呵呵，五长老说的对，若是大长老见了这小子散发出的剑意，一定会很高兴的”
薛闵圭也是甩袖笑道
“事不宜迟，此地危险，神君们的怒火不容小觑，我等还是先离去为好”

一旁书生打扮的男子说道
“那她怎么办？
却在此时有人指了指一旁晕厥的扎娜问道
“一个筑基女修而已，对于老头而言不过只是丫鬟，便赏给尔等了”
薛闵圭只是瞧了一眼随后便与众人带着杨威乘船离去
“呵呵，这小妮子，倒是水灵，我等兄弟今日有福了”
剩下几个魔眼宗弟子相视一眼呵呵一笑，当即将扎娜拖到一旁山洞之中
“砰砰砰！
却在此时众人只觉一阵头晕很快便栽倒在了地上，脑袋后面赫然已经烂了一个窟窿噗噗冒着黑血
一个大胖和尚不知什么时候出现在了众人身后，他四处望了望见无人注意后
这才火球符毁尸灭迹，接着释放乾坤袋将此女收入其中接着一溜烟遁走。
“呵呵，你们缠住我等又有何用，他最后还是要死”
宇文波冷冷笑道
在他的对面此刻正有一条通体雪白的白龙不断盘旋着，用它那锋利的爪子，牙齿不断朝着宇文波进攻
层层雪花飞舞让此龙的爆发更加恐怖，每次击打都令得宇文波连连后退
只是在看到杨威被人带走后，原本高频的进攻明显放缓了下来
敖雪成功拖住了宇文波不假，但周围同样是一片狼藉
清梦仙子受了重伤还需疗养，上官凝玉已然战败被困在齐峰用法力编制而成的牢笼之中如同一只金丝雀无法突破
筱梦真君与韩玉倒是双双取得优势压着枯竹神将与金鼠神将打然而二人到底没有下死手始终观察着情况
尤其在方才禹坤来了后他们也吓了一跳，好在对方来也快去也快并未对他们打主意
content_en:
"The fifth elder is right there."
On the flying boat of the Demon Eye Sect, Xue Mingui and his party were surrounding a middle-aged man in a green robe, pointing downwards and saying
It was on a cliff. An old man in purple robes sat cross-legged on a rock. His face was as pale as snow, but there was a small golden sword shining faintly above his head.
Beside him, an exotic woman in a black dress squatted in front of him and wiped his sweat.
"What is going on? Is he going to become a sword-minded person?
Xue Mingui couldn't help but wonder.
"Well, that's true."
The man in green robe snorted coldly
He is Yu Kun, the fifth elder of the Demon Eye Sect, known as the Blue-Eyed Demon Lord, and his strength has reached the level of becoming a god.
"Haha, his sword intention is quite good and can be used by me."
Laughing, Yu Kun had already moved. His figure instantly appeared in front of Yang Wei, and he raised his hand and pressed it on his forehead.
"Who are you? Let me go quickly."
Seeing this, Zana tried to stop her, but was knocked away by a spiritual light and hit the rocks, and fainted.
"Such a strong sword spirit, hahaha. If I hand it over to the sword-eating old ghost, I'm sure the reward will be huge."
Yu Kun was thinking in his mind, and his original intention of revenge in person had faded away. It would not be too late to take this kid's sword intent first and then kill him.
"You are so unlucky, boy"
Zhenjun Xiao Meng naturally also saw the appearance of Yu Kun. This was a real god-forming monk. Now they had nothing to do.
"Haha, the fifth elder is right. If the first elder sees the sword intent emanating from this kid, he will definitely be very happy."
Xue Mingyu also shook his sleeves and said with a smile
"Without further delay, this place is dangerous, and the anger of the gods cannot be underestimated. It would be better for us to leave first."
The man dressed as a scholar said
"Then what should she do?
But at this moment, someone pointed at Zana who was fainting and asked.
"She's just a foundation-building female cultivator. To the old man, she's just a maid, so I'll give it to you."
Xue Mingui just took a look and then left by boat with everyone and Yang Wei.
"Haha, this little girl is quite charming. Brothers and I are very blessed today."
The few remaining Demon Eye Sect disciples looked at each other and chuckled, and then dragged Zana to a cave aside.
“Bang bang bang!
But at this moment, everyone felt dizzy and soon fell to the ground. There was a hole in the back of their heads, and black blood was pouring out.
A fat monk appeared behind everyone at some point. He looked around and saw that no one was paying attention.
Only then did the fireball talisman destroy the corpse and eliminate all traces, and then released the Qiankun bag, put the girl into it, and escaped in a hurry.
"Haha, what's the use of pestering me? He will still die in the end."
Yu Wenbo sneered.
Opposite him, there was a snow-white white dragon constantly circling, using its sharp claws and teeth to attack Yu Wenbo.
The layers of snowflakes flying made the dragon's explosion even more terrifying. Every blow made Yu Wenbo retreat continuously.
But after seeing Yang Wei being taken away, the high-frequency attacks slowed down significantly.
It’s true that Ao Xue succeeded in holding Yu Wenbo back, but the surroundings were also in a mess.
Fairy Qingmeng was seriously injured and still needed to recuperate. Shangguan Ningyu had been defeated and was trapped in the cage made by Qi Feng using magic power, like a canary that could not break through.
Xiaomeng Zhenjun and Han Yu both gained the upper hand and overwhelmed the Withered Bamboo God General and the Golden Rat God General. However, they did not make a fatal move and kept observing the situation.
Especially when Yukun arrived just now, they were also shocked. Fortunately, the other party came and went quickly without making any plans for them.
